warnings.detail: PCB trace is 14.84mm long, exceeding the 10mm maximum

the schematic draws a wire between two pins of SW2 — on paper that is a permanent short across the switch, and a reviewer has to read it as a dead button. If the pins are one internal terminal, declare the pairing with internallyConnectedPins so it folds into the symbol instead of drawing as a wire; if they are not, the design itself shorts the switch

the schematic draws a wire between two pins of SW3 — on paper that is a permanent short across the switch, and a reviewer has to read it as a dead button. If the pins are one internal terminal, declare the pairing with internallyConnectedPins so it folds into the symbol instead of drawing as a wire; if they are not, the design itself shorts the switch

power net GND is routed at 0.15mm — the same copper as a signal. The current maths may pass on this board, but power at signal width is the wrong habit; the profile's power floor is 0.5mm (warn_power_trace_mm — an EE moves the line there)

power net V3_3 is routed at 0.15mm — the same copper as a signal. The current maths may pass on this board, but power at signal width is the wrong habit; the profile's power floor is 0.5mm (warn_power_trace_mm — an EE moves the line there)

power net V5 is routed at 0.15mm — the same copper as a signal. The current maths may pass on this board, but power at signal width is the wrong habit; the profile's power floor is 0.5mm (warn_power_trace_mm — an EE moves the line there)
J1 sits 0.349mm from the board edge; the assembly line grips the outer 2.5mm and needs 1mm as an absolute floor
U3 sits exactly on the 0.4mm pitch floor — legal, with no margin for a footprint revision

7 part(s) are in package families whose zero-rotation convention differs between EDA output and JLCPCB's library: J1, LED1, LED2, U1, U2, U4, Y1. Check pin-1 on each in the placement preview before paying — that screen is the only place this is catchable
USB_DP routes 51.71mm and USB_DM 37.80mm — 13.91mm of intra-pair skew against a 3.8mm budget (USB 2.0, ~150ps on FR-4). Length-match the pair or shorten the longer leg

USB_DP/USB_DM run within 0.60mm of each other (4x the 0.15mm trace) for only 7% of the run — a differential pair should travel together (widest gap 15.21mm). The router cannot hold a pair yet, so this is reported, not fixed: review the pair before ordering

every routed segment on this board is 0.15mm — the same copper for GND, V3_3, V5 as for a button signal. No net class distinguishes power from signal, so each rail carries whatever the router's default happens to be (604mA at 10degC by IPC-2221B)
U2's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin VIN is 9.7mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (1 pin(s) are further)
U3's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin IOVDD3 is 6.1mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (2 pin(s) are further)
2 signal(s) leave the board through J1 with no ESD clamp on them (J1.A5, J1.B5). A finger on a connector is several kilovolts
1 rail(s) have nowhere to put a probe (V3_3). Add a test point — nobody can diagnose a dead board over chat without one
U2 dissipates 0.23W at 134mA and sits about 59 degC junction, 66 degC inside the limit

the converted board was held to the fab's silkscreen floors before plotting: 52 silkscreen text(s) raised to the fab's minimum height (smallest was 0.267mm); 55 given an explicit stroke; 165 silkscreen stroke(s) widened (thinnest was 0.1000mm); 1 missing via(s) added under a B.Cu dead-end at a top-only pad
